board.title: Meet the board
board.intro: Six parts you will use lab after lab. Drag the board to turn it; pick a part to light it up and see which labs use it.
board.c5Intro: Explore the Pulsar C5 in 3D: rotate, zoom and open the component menu to locate each part.

usb.title: USB-C and controls
usb.text: One port for power, programming and serial console. BOOT uses GPIO28; RESET restarts the board.

mcu.title: ESP32-C5HR8
mcu.text: RISC-V processor with 8 MiB of in-package PSRAM and 8 MiB of external QSPI flash.

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.text: Onboard pressure, temperature and humidity, proximity and light, and magnetic sensing over I²C.

rgb.title: Indicators
rgb.text: A WS2812 1010 RGB LED, plus user, power and charge LEDs.

power.title: Battery and power
power.text: BQ24074 charges the Li-ion battery; MAX17048 monitors it and SGM6029 regulates 3.3 V.

storage.title: microSD and SPI
storage.text: A microSD slot and six-pin J20 connector share the SPI bus.

radio.title: Radio and antenna
radio.text: 2.4/5 GHz Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth LE 5 and 802.15.4 through a coaxial RF antenna connector.

headers.title: Pins and QWIIC
headers.text: 30 Nano-style positions. QWIIC uses GPIO1/GPIO6; onboard sensors use GPIO2/GPIO3.
